sources.finding: SWR reported police investigation of suspected targeted anti-gay assaults at Stuttgart-Degerloch cruising locations and two A81 rest stops between June 2025 and April 2026. Ten injured, five suspects searched. Article does not identify exact coordinates of every attack.
Local reporting explicitly identifies safety concerns and assaults affecting the Stuttgart TV tower/woodland cruising scene.
Stuttgart police state cruising itself is lawful but requires regard for others and entails legal risks.

recommendation: Keep 920 as a research candidate, but flag significant reported recent violence and verify safety situation before publishing or recommending. Do not publish unsafe walking instructions or imply guaranteed safe activity.
not_an_activity_verification: News independently supports the existence of a cruising scene at Stuttgart-Degerloch, not predictability of crowd/time or legality of any specific public sexual acts.
